name: Kieni
description: A long-running Direct Trade relationship coffee from a Nyeri cooperative, with a full, clean body and dark-berry sweetness. Also sold in an espresso roast.

name: Vista Hermosa Espresso
description: A balanced, clean espresso roast from the family farm that was Coffee Collective's first Direct Trade partner. Soft chocolate and nut sweetness.

name: Mulugeta Anaerobic
description: An intense, aromatic anaerobic natural from a high-altitude Sidama producer who placed in Cup of Excellence 2024. Candy-like berry up front with green apple and melon.

name: Rodrigo Hoyos
description: A washed Pink Bourbon from Huila that stays bright and balanced, pairing redcurrant acidity with brown-sugar and cocoa depth.

name: Kamavindi AA
description: A washed AA lot from Peter Mbature's Kamavindi farm in Kenya, sold in both filter and espresso roasts with the same dark-berry and floral profile.

name: Tadesse Natural
description: A natural-process Ethiopian lot of the Kurume 74158 variety, juicy with stone fruit and mandarin. Available as filter and espresso roasts (this page is the espresso listing).

name: Volcan Azul
description: An SL28 grown on the Cardamomo plot of Don Alejo Castro's fifth-generation estate. Floral and plummy, offered in filter and espresso roasts.

name: Nuwa Senchi
description: The first harvest from Sonia Diaz's Geisha, Marshell and Bourbon plants in Amazonas, and Prolog's first purchase from her. Round and sweet, with stone fruit and milk chocolate.

name: Kigari AA
description: A classic Kenyan AA from a Meru cooperative of four wet mills, with lasting acidity and red-fruit sweetness. Prolog has bought from Kigari in three harvests.

name: Diima Danche
description: A certified-organic natural from the SNAP-owned Danche station in Gedeb, layering jammy berry with violet aromatics and a milk-chocolate finish.

name: Muthua-Ini
description: A washed Kenyan lot processed at the Muthua-Ini factory east of the Aberdares, dried on raised beds. Raspberry and red currant with a floral lift.

name: Santa Monica
description: A Caturra natural from third-generation grower Jairo Arcila, fermented aerobically for 45 hours before drying. Fruit-forward, with lime, apple and warm spice.

name: Los Angeles Pacamara
description: Washed Pacamara from a farm planted entirely to that variety in the Ahuachapán mountains. Wild strawberry and cherry over a toffee sweetness.

name: Kenya Gicherori
description: A light roast from smallholders around Gicherori factory on the slopes of Mount Kenya, sun-dried on raised beds. Fruity and tart with berry and lemon.

name: Ethiopia Guji
description: A juicy natural from 44 small producers in Guji, processed at Dambi Uddo and dried on raised beds. Stone fruit and kiwi with a milk-chocolate finish.

name: Ethiopia Shakiso
description: A washed Guji lot fermented in cold water for up to 100 hours, which gives a very clear, tea-like cup with apricot and floral notes.

name: Colombia Santander
description: A double-fermented, washed Castillo from the Reyes family's Hacienda El Rodeo. Fresh and sweet, with lemon and apple balanced by almond and milk chocolate.

name: Kainamui
description: A fresh, tea-like Kenyan lot from a cooperative La Cabra has bought from since 2018. Crisp red berries over sweet brown sugar; roasted to work for filter or espresso.

name: Megadu
description: A natural lot from the Bette Buna project in Guji, floral and ripe with jammy berry and apricot. Works for filter or espresso.

name: Las Flores de Cafe
description: A blend of small lots from the Huista micro-region of Huehuetenango. Crisp and sweet, with red berries, dark chocolate and raisin.

name: Traditional Espresso
description: A medium-roast espresso blend of 86% natural Rio Verde from Minas Gerais, Brazil, and 14% washed Kibigu from Embu, Kenya. Dark chocolate and marzipan sweetness with a little berry acidity.

name: Rio Verde
description: A natural Yellow Bourbon from Ipanema Coffees' Rio Verde farm in Minas Gerais, sold for filter brewing. A sweet, full cup built on dark chocolate and hazelnut.

name: San Sebastian
description: A washed Castillo from small farms around San Sebastián in Cauca, light-roasted for filter. Round and sweet, with cocoa under orange and plum and low acidity.

name: Ngerwe Espresso
description: A washed Kenyan peaberry lot roasted light for espresso. Floral and fruity, with sweetness and acidity in balance; the same coffee is also sold as a filter roast.

name: Buesaco Collective #2
description: A honey-processed community lot from producers around Buesaco in Nariño, grown at about 2000 m. A clean cup of ripe plum over a chocolate base.

name: Wamaguma PB
description: A washed peaberry lot from the Wamaguma factory in Kiambu County, roasted for both filter and espresso. Blackcurrant fruit with a cacao-nib edge; sold wholesale only.
producer: Wamaguma Coffee Factory (Ritho Farmers' Cooperative Society)

name: La Perla
description: A washed lot from a women's group in the Norcafé cooperative in Amazonas, Peru. Caramel sweetness and a buttery body under light tropical fruit.

name: Dhilgee Banko Gotiti
description: A washed heirloom lot from smallholders in Yirgacheffe, processed at the Wete Ambela station. Stone fruit and grape with a black-tea finish.

name: Zenu
description: A natural single origin from Jimma in southwest Ethiopia, dark-roasted for espresso. A mellow, low-acid shot led by chocolate and nougat.

name: Desta
description: A dark-roast espresso blend of natural Jimma and washed Sidama coffees. Chocolate and nougat from the Jimma side, citrus and florals from the Sidama side.

name: Mount Kenya
description: A washed Kenyan coffee from the Mount Kenya region, sold as a dark roast. Full-bodied, with berry and citrus over a milk-chocolate note.

name: Kimathi Blend
description: A dark-roast blend of washed beans from Mount Kenya and sun-dried beans from Jimma, Ethiopia. Floral, mildly acidic and balanced in body.

name: Hidden Hour
description: A natural Catuai from Finca El Puente in La Paz, Honduras, roasted for both filter and espresso. Jammy and sweet, with chocolate and almond underneath.
producer: Finca El Puente (Marysabel Caballero, Moises Herrera)

name: Daybreak
description: A washed Catuai from Finca El Puente in La Paz, Honduras, roasted for filter and espresso. Toffee and nougat sweetness with a soft baked-apple fruit.
producer: Finca El Puente (Marysabel Caballero, Moises Herrera)

name: Cosmic Canopy
description: A natural Kurume from Harruu Bunnaqaa farms in Guji, roasted for filter. Delicate and floral, with lychee and jasmine.

name: Twin Rivers
description: A red-honey San Isidro from Finca Carrizal in Costa Rica, roasted for filter. A light, sweet cup of starfruit and pear with a vanilla note.

name: Volcancito Caturra
description: A honey-processed Caturra from POMA's partner farm Volcán Azul in Costa Rica, roasted light. Stone fruit meets warm spice and a nougat sweetness.

name: San Sebastian Castillo
description: A washed Castillo from San Sebastián in Cauca, Colombia, roasted light. Clean and crisp, with a light body and a sweet, biscuit-like finish.

name: Las Brisas Bourbon Aji
description: A washed Bourbon Aji from Las Brisas in Colombia, dried slowly over 20 days and roasted light. Strongly floral and tea-like, with a hint of brown spice.

name: Volcán Azul SL28
description: A washed SL28 grown on the slopes of the Poás volcano in Costa Rica, roasted light. Red-berry and stone-fruit character with a floral edge.

name: PS Blend
description: A Honduras and Peru blend roasted to work as espresso or filter. Very low acidity, a medium-heavy body and dark chocolate sweetness.

name: Proexo Espresso Blend
description: An organic Honduran espresso blend from Proexo and several smallholders. Smooth and easygoing, with chocolate and nut sweetness.

name: Tricolore
description: An organic dark-roast espresso blend in the Italian style, with some robusta in the mix. Round and strong, with no acidity to speak of.

name: Momentum
description: An organic dark-roast blend made for any brewer, including bean-to-cup machines. Full body, low acidity and plenty of sweetness.

name: Scuro
description: An organic espresso blend of natural Brazil and washed Ethiopia, roasted medium-dark. Low acidity and a full body, with some fruit still showing.

name: Chiaro
description: Kaffevaerk's organic house espresso, a medium-roast blend of Brazil and Honduras. Works as a straight shot and in milk drinks.

name: Brasilien
description: An organic natural Brazil from the Dutra family farm in Minas Gerais, roasted medium. Soft and round, for French press, filter or a mild espresso.
region: São João do Manhuaçu, Minas Gerais

name: Kenya Mørkristet
description: A washed Kenya AA Plus from Nyeri on Mount Kenya, roasted dark. Intense and full-bodied, with dark fruit and chocolate.

name: Brasilien Mørkristet
description: A hand-picked natural Brazil from the Cerrado, roasted dark with espresso and milk drinks in mind. Round and full, with caramel, nuts and chocolate.

name: Colombia Mellemristet
description: A washed, sun-dried Colombian from Huila, roasted medium for espresso, filter or French press. Full-bodied, with almond and a caramel finish.

name: Rwanda Mellemristet
description: A washed Bourbon from Karongi District in Rwanda, given a darker medium roast that suits espresso. Rich body, light acidity and a chocolatey finish.

name: Darkness My Old Friend
description: A washed Honduran coffee from Copan roasted medium-dark for espresso and milk drinks, with a dark-chocolate and hazelnut cup.

name: Easy Like Sunday Morning
description: A medium-roast filter blend of natural Brazil and washed Honduras, built for batch and drip brewing, with a nutty, chocolatey cup.

name: Don't Let Me Down
description: A medium-roast espresso blend of Honduran and Indonesian arabica with 25% Ugandan robusta, giving a strong, nutty cup with milk-chocolate sweetness.

name: Monte Nevado
description: An organic washed lot from a single Copan farm, roasted medium for both espresso and filter, with a nutty, milk-chocolate profile and some yellow fruit.

name: Fazenda Dois Irmãos
description: A natural Red Catuai from a single Cerrado Mineiro estate, light roasted, with a creamy, full body and cashew, hazelnut and chocolate flavours.

name: Limu
description: A washed Grade 2 Ethiopian from Limu, medium roasted and sold whole or ground in light and dark versions, with chocolate, soft fruit and a lightly spiced finish.

name: Guji
description: A Grade 1 Ethiopian from Guji, medium roasted and sold whole or ground in light and dark versions, with a floral, berry-and-citrus cup and lively acidity.

name: Sidamo
description: A natural Grade 1 Ethiopian from Sidamo, medium roasted and sold whole or ground in light and dark versions, with jasmine, citrus and a clean, gentle sweetness.

name: Yirgacheffe
description: A washed Grade 2 Ethiopian from Yirgacheffe, medium roasted and sold whole or ground in light and dark versions, with a floral, citrusy cup and a tea-like body.

name: Endless Night
variety: Castillo, Cenicafe, Red Catuai, Yellow Bourbon
description: A dark espresso blend of washed and natural coffees from Brazil, Colombia and Costa Rica, also suited to moka pot and AeroPress. Round and full in the cup with cocoa and dark caramel.

name: KeHo
description: A Kenya and Honduras house blend for filter, French press and Chemex. The Kenyan part brings dark berry and tea depth, the Honduran part milk chocolate and a soft, round body.

name: CoTa
description: A Costa Rica and Tanzania blend meant for filter, French press and pour-over. Sweet and soft at first, with a light fruity finish.

name: Bela Epoca
description: A natural Yellow Bourbon from a family farm in Alta Mogiana, roasted medium. A low-acid, chocolate-and-caramel cup.

name: Humure
description: A natural Red Bourbon from the Humure washing station in Gatsibo, roasted medium. Orchard fruit and orange over hazelnut, chocolate and caramel.

name: Las Petunias
description: A washed Bourbon and Caturra lot from smallholders in Antioquia, sold in a medium or a dark roast. Caramel sweetness with red fruit and apple.

name: Finca Churupampa
description: An organic washed Peruvian coffee from Finca Churupampa, roasted medium-dark. Dark chocolate and nuts with a light fruity edge.

name: Selección Planadas
description: An organic washed Colombian from a Tolima cooperative, roasted medium for both filter and espresso. Ripe fruit over milk chocolate and caramel, with a silky body.

name: Abakundakawa Rushashi
description: A washed Rwandan Bourbon from the Abakundakawa cooperative, roasted medium for V60, French press or espresso. Honey-sweet with tropical fruit and a clean citrus finish.

name: Santos
description: A natural Brazilian from São Paulo, offered in several roast levels from medium-light to dark and suited to espresso, V60 and French press. Soft and balanced, with chocolate and nut sweetness.

name: Casa Mogiana
description: A natural Brazilian from Alta Mogiana aimed at espresso and milk drinks. Round and sweet with low acidity and a full body.

name: Rungeto Jam
description: A washed SL28 and SL34 lot from the Karimikui factory in Kirinyaga, sold in filter and espresso roasts. A sweet, jammy Kenyan with caramel and a tea-like finish, sweeter than it is acidic.
producer: Karimikui Factory, Rung'eto Farmers Cooperative Society

name: Skåstrup Espresso Blend
description: A dark espresso blend of Brazilian and Peruvian arabica with Indian robusta. Creamy and full, with cocoa, nuts and caramel.

name: Colombia Espresso Crema
description: A dark espresso blend of Colombian Supremo arabica from Tolima and Indian robusta. Creamy and full, with nuts and cocoa and a hint of cranberry.

name: Skåstrup Special Blend
description: A medium-roast house blend of Brazilian and Ugandan Bourbon arabica, sold whole or ground for filter. Round, strong and sweet, with cocoa and nuts.
